### Migrate from `FastMCP.as_proxy()` to `create_proxy()`

Source: https://github.com/prefecthq/fastmcp/blob/main/docs/getting-started/upgrading/from-fastmcp-2.mdx

Replace `FastMCP.as_proxy()` with `create_proxy()` for creating proxy instances. Note that the `backend` keyword argument was renamed to `target` in the new API.

```python
# Removed in v4
proxy = FastMCP.as_proxy("http://example.com/mcp")
proxy = FastMCP.as_proxy(backend="http://example.com/mcp")  # keyword form
```

```python
# New
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy
proxy = create_proxy("http://example.com/mcp")
proxy = create_proxy(target="http://example.com/mcp")  # as_proxy(backend=X) "u2192" create_proxy(target=X)
```

Source: https://github.com/prefecthq/fastmcp/blob/main/fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/server.py

```python
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy
from fastmcp.server.middleware import Middleware, MiddlewareContext, CallNext
from fastmcp import FastMCP

class MetricsMiddleware(Middleware):
    async def on_call_tool(self, context: MiddlewareContext, call_next: CallNext):
        tool_name = context.params.name
        return await call_next(context)

original_server = FastMCP("MyServer")
proxy = create_proxy(original_server)
proxy.add_middleware(MetricsMiddleware())
```

### Running a Proxy Server over Streamable-HTTP on Host/Port

Source: https://github.com/prefecthq/fastmcp/blob/main/fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/mixins/transport.py

Shows how to run a proxy server over streamable-http transport using run_http_async() with custom middleware.

```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy
from fastmcp.server.middleware import Middleware, MiddlewareContext, CallNext
from fastmcp.mcp_config import MCPConfig
from pathlib import Path

class LoggingMiddleware(Middleware):
    async def on_call_tool(self, context: MiddlewareContext, call_next: CallNext):
        result = await call_next(context)
        return result

config = MCPConfig.from_file(Path("mcp_config.json"))
proxy_server = create_proxy(config)
proxy_server.add_middleware(LoggingMiddleware())

await proxy_server.run_http_async(
    transport="streamable-http",
    host="0.0.0.0",
    port=8080,
    path="/mcp"
)
```

### Authenticated Proxy Server

Source: https://github.com/prefecthq/fastmcp/blob/main/docs/integrations/claude-desktop.mdx

This Python script shows how to create an authenticated proxy server using FastMCP. It uses a BearerAuth client to connect to a remote server with an access token, then passes this client to the proxy.

```python
from fastmcp import Client
from fastmcp.client.auth import BearerAuth
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy

# Create authenticated client
client = Client(
    "https://api.example.com/mcp/sse",
    auth=BearerAuth(token="your-access-token")
)

# Create proxy using the authenticated client
proxy = create_proxy(client, name="Authenticated Proxy")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    proxy.run()
```
